================================================================================
FLEX GUI PRO NO AFTER EFFECTS - NĀ MEA HOU
Paʻi 9.2.9  -  ʻOkakopa 2026
================================================================================

Hui pū nā KUMUHANA ANIME hou he 33 me nā kumuhana Demon Slayer, ʻike maoli ʻia nā hopena ʻiole o
nā kumuhana i loko o After Effects i kēia manawa, a hoʻokahi papa koho hāʻule maʻemaʻe ka Mea Koho Kumuhana.

MA MUA O KA HOʻOMAKA
- Hoʻokomo ma luna o kou paʻi o kēia manawa me kāu mea hoʻokomo ZXP maʻamau, a laila hoʻomaka hou iā
  After Effects i hoʻokahi manawa.
- Mālama ʻia kāu mau hoʻonohonoho, kumuhana, preset, a me nā expression i waiho ʻia.

HOU: 33 KUMUHANA ANIME
- Aia i kēia manawa ma Nā Hoʻonohonoho Flex > MEA KOHO KUMUHANA > KUMUHANA PANEL
  hoʻokahi pūʻulu no kēlā me kēia anime:
  Attack on Titan (Levi), Berserk (Guts), Black Clover (Asta), Bleach (Ichigo,
  Hitsugaya), Chainsaw Man (Denji, Reze), Code Geass (Lelouch), Dandadan
  (Okarun), Death Note (Kira), Dragon Ball (Goku), Frieren, Fullmetal
  Alchemist (Edward), Hunter x Hunter (Killua, Kurapika, Hisoka), Jujutsu
  Kaisen (Gojo, Sukuna), KonoSuba (Megumin), Mob Psycho 100 (Mob), My Hero
  Academia (Bakugo, Deku, Todoroki), Naruto (Itachi, Minato), One Piece
  (Luffy, Zoro, Law), One-Punch Man (Saitama), Re:Zero (Rem), Solo Leveling
  (Jinwoo), Spy x Family (Anya) a me Tokyo Ghoul (Kaneki).
- He helehelena ponoʻī ko kēlā me kēia kanaka: ka mea e hahai ana i kou ʻiole, ka hoʻouka ke
  kaomi ʻoe i kekahi pihi, ka mea e hana ʻia ana i kou paʻa ʻana i ka pihi hema, a me ka
  pahū ma hope o kou paʻa ʻana no ka 2.5 kekona paha.
- Māmā like nō me nā kumuhana Demon Slayer: holo wale nā hopena ke hoʻoneʻe a kaomi paha
  ʻoe. E hoʻopau i NĀ HOPENA AMBIENT i mālama wale i nā waihoʻoluʻu.

HOʻOLOLI ʻIA: MEA KOHO KUMUHANA
- Ua hala nā kāleka Demon Slayer ma lalo o KUMUHANA PANEL, no laila ua ʻoi aku ka pōkole o
  Nā Hoʻonohonoho Flex. E koho i kēlā me kēia kumuhana mai ka papa koho hāʻule KUMUHANA PANEL;
  wehe ʻia ia ma ke kumuhana āu e hoʻohana nei.
- Aia ʻo Kurama lāua ʻo Baryon i ka pūʻulu Naruto i kēia manawa.

HOʻOPONOPONO ʻIA
- ʻAʻole i ʻike pinepine ʻia nā hopena ʻiole o nā kumuhana (wai, ahi, uwila a me nā mea ʻē aʻe)
  i loko o After Effects, ʻoiai ua pio ka Optimised Mode. Ua manaʻo ʻia nā manawa paʻahana o ka
  panel ponoʻī, a me ka hoʻomaka paʻahana, he lohi ko ke kumuhana, no laila ua hoʻopau nā
  hopena iā lākou iho. I kēia manawa, ke kaha kāu kāleka kiʻi iā lākou (ka hapa nui o nā
  kamepiula), hoʻomāmā wale kēlā mau manawa i nā hopena no kekahi manawa pōkole.

HOʻOLOLI ʻOLE ʻIA
- Hana like nō ka laikini, ka hoʻāla ʻana, a me nā loulou a pau e like me mua.
- Like loa ke ʻano o nā kumuhana Demon Slayer he 11 me ka paʻi 9.2.8.
- Like nō me ka paʻi 9.2.8 ka hana ʻana o kēlā me kēia tab a me ka mea hana ʻē aʻe.
================================================================================
